why: A (universe 0) is Morse.IsLeviCivita.conn_eq: for ANY real Lie algebra L, form B and bilinear D with IsLeviCivita B D, (∀X, D X X = 0) ⇒ D X Y = ½⁅X,Y⁆ — pure algebra; 'X ⊢ X = 0' is a hypothesis. B: on a Lie group with a bi-invariant metric and Levi-Civita connection, (i) integral curves of X_v are left translates of one-parameter subgroups, (ii) they are geodesics, (iii) X ⊢ X = 0, (iv) X ⊢ Y = ½[X,Y] as fields. B ⇒ A only vacuously (A re-proved: Milnor's expansion). A ⇒ B fails genuinely: (i)–(iii) are Lie-group geometry (Lemma 21.2; uniqueness of integral curves; geodesic equation) not in the project. Bridge proved with A as hypothesis (d_of_geod, #rt_check OK): on every Lie group and for every SYMMETRIC connection, (iii) ⇒ (iv): at each p, D u v := (dL_p)⁻¹((X_u ⊢ X_v)(p)) is bilinear on 𝔤 with torsion ⁅u,v⁆ (8.5 + Mathlib's [X_u,X_v] = X_⁅u,v⁆ + C^∞ of X_u), so A applies with B := 0 (A's metric hypothesis is superfluous for (d)). Hence, given A, B ↔ (i)∧(ii)∧(iii) (B_iff_core): A is exactly B's algebraic step.
